entities.summary: Nail Narimanovich Mukhamedyarov is a Soviet weightlifter. He won a Silver medal in the 90 kg class at the 1988 Summer Olympics in Seoul. Mukhamedyarov also won a Silver medal in the 110 kg class at the 1990 World Weightlifting Championships in Budapest.
